name: Review UI, Single Artifact Player Sync & No Social Gate

consumed_backend_outcome_fields.project_id: string - ID of the canonical project associated with the video
consumed_backend_outcome_fields.run_id: string - Unique execution run ID for the generation/edit job
consumed_backend_outcome_fields.deliverable_url: string - Primary video stream / mp4 url
consumed_backend_outcome_fields.download_url: string - Direct mp4 download URL for client-side export
consumed_backend_outcome_fields.sha256: string - SHA256 checksum of physical rendered MP4

media_probe.duration_seconds: number - Exact physical media duration measured via ffprobe

consumed_backend_outcome_fields.duration_seconds: number - Fallback duration in seconds if media_probe is omitted
consumed_backend_outcome_fields.publication_requested: boolean | string - 'true' or 'REQUESTED' only when user explicitly requested social publishing
consumed_backend_outcome_fields.publication_status: string - Current publishing queue status if requested (e.g. PENDING_SOCIAL_AUTHORIZATION, PUBLISHED)
consumed_backend_outcome_fields.state: string - Outcome status: SUCCEEDED | FAILED_TERMINAL | BLOCKED | BLOCKED_UNAUTHORIZED_BACKGROUND_AI | FAILED_RETRYABLE
consumed_backend_outcome_fields.blocker_reason: string - Truthful error description on failure
consumed_backend_outcome_fields.message: string - User-facing progress or error message

ui_contract_guarantees.zero_social_gate_for_edit_only: When publication_requested is false or omitted, the Review panel completely suppresses 'review-publishing-status' and never shows PENDING_CREDENTIALS or blocks MP4 playback/download.
ui_contract_guarantees.honest_duration_sync: No hardcoded 15.00s fallback in player or review panel. Uses media_probe.duration_seconds first, then timeline duration, or real video onLoadedMetadata duration.
ui_contract_guarantees.atomic_deliverable_invalidation: On terminal failure (e.g. BLOCKED_UNAUTHORIZED_BACKGROUND_AI, FAILED_TERMINAL) or new run dispatch, old stale video and deliverables are atomically cleared from state so the user never sees a previous run's completed video or fake success.
ui_contract_guarantees.single_player_identity: StudioPreviewStage remounts cleanly on artifact key change, resets currentTime to 0, and player scrubber/timecode displays the exact physical media duration.
ui_contract_guarantees.export_integrity: The Export Output action prefers download_url, falls back to preview_ref/video_url, and names the downloaded file with canonical output_id or artifact_id.
